=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose phase runs issue-derived content with `--sandbox danger-full-access` after removal of the brokered read-only execution path, while `GH_TOKEN` and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` remain available.
  WHY: Prompt-injected content can read or exfiltrate credentials and mutate or push workspace state; the same change also hard-codes `${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml` instead of honoring `CODEX_HOME`.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: removed `is_sensitive_target_path` (old lines 155-168); `normalize_path` at lines 240-247 no longer calls it | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and the `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` / `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` bounds were removed, allowing untrusted in-repository paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh/id_ed25519`, and `.aws/credentials` to be read into model prompts.
  WHY: Repository-root containment does not exclude sensitive files inside the tree, so secrets can be exposed to the model and persisted in logs or memory.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: `_inject_token_into_url` at 3040-3052 and `_resolve_origin_url` at 3081-3083 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication was replaced with HTTPS URLs containing `x-access-token:TOKEN@...`.
  WHY: The PAT is exposed in git argv, `/proc`, diagnostics, process listings, and temporary clone remotes, violating the credential-free URL contract and the repository's authentication hygiene tests.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` at line 581 (`printf 'https://x-access-token:%s@%s/%s\n'`); `memory_ensure_branch` at lines 151 and 180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was deleted, force-tick URLs embed `GH_PAT`/`GH_TOKEN`, and `memory_ensure_branch` uses unauthenticated bare `git ls-remote` and `git push`.
  WHY: Tokens leak through process arguments and diagnostics, while `persist-credentials: false` leaves private-repository origins unauthenticated; fail-open handling silently stops memory branch initialization and writes. Severity differs between the authentication defect and its silent failure consequence; the highest severity is used.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 143-528 (deleted broker functions) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `model_provider_broker_*` API was deleted while live workflows, scripts, and tests still call it.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with `model_provider_broker_start: command not found` before Codex executes, and the credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7; removed `--process-group-file` case block (old lines 52-58) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` was removed although `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh` and tests still pass it.
  WHY: The guard exits with an unknown-option error before isolated editors launch.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: _kill_child_group_if_running at 290-303 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user process-group metadata, privileged signaling, identity checks, and survivor verification were deleted.
  WHY: `nobody` descendants can outlive the wrapper and retain workspace access while cleanup restores ownership.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: removed `git_with_github_auth` (old lines 496-507); removed `review_blocked_decision_digest`, `review_blocked_find_pending_request`, `review_blocked_build_approval_request`, `review_blocked_approval_status`, `review_blocked_post_approval_request`, `review_blocked_post_consumed_marker`, `review_blocked_find_issue_for_request`, `review_blocked_build_successor_intent`, `review_blocked_successor_marker`, `review_blocked_ensure_successor_intent`, `review_blocked_resolve_successor_issue`, `review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue` (old lines 975-1349) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authenticated git wrapper and review-blocked approval/successor helper APIs were deleted while live callers remain.
  WHY: Review-blocked terminal decisions and successor flows fail, command substitutions abort under `set -euo pipefail`, and judge-fix or baseline pushes fail or silently skip.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: REST transform at line 769; GraphQL selection at lines 836-840; jq transform at lines 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR-comment payloads no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked approval authentication cannot bind trusted producers or approvers, and thread resolution cannot map audited comments to comment IDs.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: removed `--provider-base-url` from usage (line 32), option parser (line 108), variable (line 100), validation (lines 146-149) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `--provider-base-url` CLI option was removed and the base URL was hard-coded while `orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5241-5244` still passes the option.
  WHY: Config generation exits on an unknown argument, breaking the security pass; hard-coding the public endpoint also bypasses loopback broker routing.

- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: `codex_config_assemble` option list at line 65 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` removed `--provider-base-url` while existing callers still pass it.
  WHY: Config assembly aborts before editor, consolidator, resolver, judge, and poller phases start.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: line 30 (`MAX_TARGET_PATHS`), line 37 (`is_sensitive_target_path`), lines 714-781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests still import deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError` before targeted-file-context tests execute.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: staged-support restore block at lines 101-237 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore/rebase block is gated on variables that no workflow step creates or exports, and the companion `SSB_*` escalation path is likewise unwired.
  WHY: The helper-clobbering regression remains unmitigated and the `ai:needs-human` path is unreachable.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: pre_assembled_static.txt cleanup at lines 62-66 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup checks index membership instead of HEAD membership, restores only the worktree, and removed the cached-removal branch.
  WHY: Newly staged files can make `git restore --source=HEAD` fail under `set -e`, while staged artifact changes can remain in the implementation commit.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (~lines 536-716) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary, and overflow markers do not advance `used_bytes`, and the path-count cap was removed.
  WHY: An untrusted path list can produce output far beyond `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`, exceeding the prompt budget.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
